request.answer: Provider may increase the fees for any renewal term by up to 3% over the fees for the preceding term by giving notice at least ninety (90) days before the renewal date. If Provider fails to meet this commitment in a calendar month, Customer will receive a service credit equal to 5% of the monthly fee for each full hour of unavailability, up to a maximum of 10% of the monthly fee for that month. These obligations continue for five (5) years after termination or expiration of this Agreement.

request.instructions: The source is one version of an agreement. Each claim is a sentence taken from the other version of the same agreement. A claim is supported when the source states the same obligation, right, amount, rate, period, party and place, even if the wording, spelling, punctuation or number formatting differs. A claim is contradicted when the source states something different about any of those. Judge each claim against the passage of the source that covers the same subject.
